tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List the hostnames this API key can receive mail on, with their status. Any address at an active hostname reaches the inbox.

tools.name: get_latest_otp
tools.description: Return the newest message sent to an address and the verification code (OTP) extracted from it. Returns found=false when nothing has arrived yet; wait a few seconds and retry.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List recent messages, newest first, optionally only those sent to one address. Returns metadata and the OTP, not the body.

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Return one message by id, including its plain-text body (truncated to 20,000 characters).
